_about: Free-tier chat endpoints (OpenAI-compatible), from github.com/mnfst/awesome-free-llm-apis (data.json, 2026-10-05). Order = preference. trains: whether the provider may train on / log free-tier prompts (true, false, unknown). Only providers with trains=false receive data marked private. Keys come from the named env var (or ~/.config/freellm/env); keyless providers have key_env null. Model ids drift: run `freellm.py models` after adding keys and fix them here. Optional body / body_text / body_vision: extra request fields (e.g. OpenRouter's provider.data_collection=deny, a training-free route on the same account).

providers.name: groq
providers.limits: 30 RPM, 1,000 RPD; qwen vision: 8,000 tokens/min and 200,000 tokens/day (~125 footage strips or ~200 result strips a day)

providers.name: gemini
providers.limits: 15 RPM, 1,500 RPD (free-tier prompts may be used by Google outside the EEA/UK/CH)

providers.name: mistral
providers.limits: ~1 RPS; trains unless you opt out in the console (then set trains=false)

providers.name: openrouter-nolog
providers.limits: 20 RPM, 50 RPD on free models (1,000 with credits). body.provider.data_collection=deny routes only to endpoints that neither retain nor train on prompts (2026-10-11: Gemma :free runs only on Google AI Studio and is excluded; dots-3 runs on AtlasCloud).

providers.name: ovh
providers.limits: 2 RPM per IP per model, anonymous
